<mxfile host="make-drawio-svg" type="device"><diagram id="page-1" name="AI drafts; you own the judgment"><mxGraphModel dx="800" dy="600" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="640" pageHeight="600" math="0" shadow="0"><root><mxCell id="0" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0" /><mxCell id="human-context" value="You supply
context + constraints" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eaf2fb;strokeColor=#29577b;fontColor=#224466;strokeWidth=3;fontSize=34;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="30" y="30" width="580" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="ai-drafts" value="AI drafts
alternatives" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1ebf7;strokeColor=#76518f;fontColor=#4c2c68;strokeWidth=3;fontSize=34;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="30" y="240" width="580" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="human-decision" value="You review
and decide" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eaf2fb;strokeColor=#29577b;fontColor=#224466;strokeWidth=3;fontSize=34;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="30" y="450" width="580" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e1" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=3;" edge="1" parent="1" source="human-context" target="ai-drafts"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="e2" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeWidth=3;" edge="1" parent="1" source="ai-drafts" target="human-decision"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
svg.title: AI drafts; you own the judgment
svg.desc: A top-to-bottom human-AI-human flow: you supply context and constraints; AI drafts alternatives; you review and decide. Drafts can lower the cost of trying an approach, but are not guarantees of correctness.
